results.title: Ghana announces Nya Gyidie offshore discovery in new carbonate play
results.snippet: (WO) – Planet One Oil and Gas has made a hydrocarbon discovery at the Nya Gyidie-1X exploration well in the Deepwater Cape Three Points contract area offshore Ghana, President John Dramani Mahama announced at the 2026 Local Content Conference in Takoradi. The globe-trotting streamer says his Africa tour drew him to sign on to “The Eyes of Ghana,” released free for his enormous YouTube audience.

6 min

Chris Tsui Hesse, 93, documented Ghana's history as the personal cameraman of Kwame Nkrumah, the nation's first prime minister. (Breakwater Studios)
